Use `sgb` to validate, edit, create, and recover Omeka S records. Select the item set with `--item-set-id` or `ITEM_SET_ID`.

## Install and configure

Run `uv sync --locked` in the repository. Set `OMEKA_URL` to your Omeka instance URL. For access to private records, set `KEY_IDENTITY` and `KEY_CREDENTIAL`.

## Validate records

```sh
uv run --locked sgb download --item-set-id 10780
uv run --locked sgb validate data/raw_itemset_10780_TIMESTAMP --export-csv
uv run --locked sgb validate --item-set-id 10780 --export-csv
```

Use the directory that `download` prints. Add `--check-uris` to check external links. View the CSV files and metrics on the [Validation Reports](validation-reports.qmd) page.

See the [repository guide](https://github.com/Stadt-Geschichte-Basel/sgb-data-validator#readme) for the full commands and examples.
